title: Barn Owls Catch Mice in Total Darkness by Sound Alone
subject: barn owl

scenes.text: Barn owls hunt mice they can't even see.
In darkened labs, scientists proved they can find and catch prey by sound alone.
The secret is crooked ears. The openings sit at different heights on the skull.
Timing tells it left from right. Loudness tells it up from down.
A dish of stiff feathers around the face funnels sound into those ears.
It pinpoints the source to within one and a half degrees. In the dark, it doesn't see the mouse. It hears exactly where it is.

description:
Barn owls can find and catch prey by sound alone.
Their ears sit at different heights, and a dish of stiff feathers funnels sound in, pinpointing prey to within 1.5 degrees.
Would you survive a night with an owl that hears this well?
